checklist.note: body addresses the human author; no directive aimed at a reading agent; the 2026-10-19 edit only renames the quality tool in prose; no new instruction to the agent beyond pointing at save-result.mjs --quality
no code that sends repo/user/context data anywhere; the edit names a local repo script that writes evals/result.json; nothing leaves the machine
no key, token, or credential embedded; the edit adds no key, token or credential
destructive strings appear only as prose examples of what to look for; none executed; the edit adds no shell command beyond a mention of a local script that writes one JSON file
plain markdown throughout; nothing encoded or unreadable-on-purpose; plain prose
no download-and-run or reach to an external host; the edit contacts no host
no read of ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, .env, keychain, cookies, or a token store; the edit reads no credential store
no sudo/setuid/persistence; no write outside the working tree; the edit adds no sudo, cron, profile or launch agent
